design.name: 驼碑力士
design.brief: A hulking camel strongman tank: an anthropomorphic Bactrian camel with a huge barrel chest, long neck and a grumpy heavy-lidded camel face with a split lip, shaggy brown fur on the shoulders and forearms. Two stone tablets (石碑) are strapped upright over its two humps with ropes, the gap between the humps glowing white-gold with carved inscriptions (weak spot). Wears a faded Dunhuang-patterned saddle blanket as a skirt, bronze nose ring and bells, wrapped shins. Big hands with a clearly separate thumb and four thick fingers; big two-toed camel feet with split hooves wrapped in cloth.
design.weapon: a massive carved stone stele used as a tower shield, held in front
design.turnaround_pose: a heavy guard stance built around a tower shield that is NOT drawn (the stele shield is a separate model): feet a little wider than shoulder width, knees slightly bent, torso upright. Its own LEFT arm (on the viewer's RIGHT in the front view) is bent about 90 degrees at the elbow: the upper arm hangs down beside the ribs with a clear gap, the forearm is held HORIZONTAL at navel height and points across the front of the body toward its right hip, about one forearm-width in front of the belly with a clear gap of air between forearm and belly, the left hand closed in an EMPTY fist with the thumb on top, knuckles facing forward, as if gripping a vertical shield handle, nothing in the hand. Its own RIGHT arm hangs relaxed a little away from the body with the elbow slightly bent, right hand an empty loose fist beside the thigh with a clear gap. The camel head and long curved neck face straight ahead with the bronze nose ring; the two stone tablets strapped upright over the two humps on its back with red ropes, the gap between the humps showing the carved inscription glowing white-gold (painted as an opaque bright engraving, no halo); same fur, bells, rope necklace, Dunhuang saddle-blanket skirt and cloth-wrapped shins as the design. In the side views the bent left arm and the gap in front of the belly must be clearly readable.
design.turnaround_digits: each big hand with one clearly separate thumb and four thick fingers: the left fist with four curled fingers and the thumb visible, the right hand a loose fist with countable fingers; each foot a big two-toed camel foot with two split hoof toes wrapped in cloth, both toes visible; the tablets, ears and skirt fully inside the frame.
design.turnaround_pose_v1: standing upright in a relaxed A-pose, arms hanging a little away from the body, BOTH HANDS EMPTY and open (NO stele shield, no weapon: the shield is a separate model), feet shoulder-width apart; the camel head facing straight ahead with the bronze nose ring; the two stone tablets strapped upright over the two humps on its back with red ropes, the gap between the humps showing the carved inscription glowing white-gold (painted as an opaque bright engraving, no halo); same fur, bells, rope necklace, Dunhuang saddle-blanket skirt and cloth-wrapped shins as the design
